method: 3D SIMP topology optimization (parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/topopt.py), then PicoGK smoothing and exact functional features
basis_note: Planform, height, flange, lids and tensioner position are concept-f0.json hypotheses (no measured engine-case face, shafts or tensioner). Gasket and tensioner loads are stated assumptions, not measurements. The 2.5 mm skin, flange, bosses, lids and tensioner boss are fixed (shaping.base_stl from engine/bionic_bases.py, primitive subsets in the FE model); the ribbing that carries the clamp and tensioner loads is optimised in a band outside the skin, never inside the chain space.
